summary: dellemc.openmanage known issues for 10.2.0: no SOCKS proxy export in idrac_diagnostics, no authenticated shares for idrac_firmware on iDRAC8, a false success in idrac_storage_volume on BOSS-N1, failing SupportAssist export on OME 4.0.0, and same-named uplinks being modified.
questions: Which openmanage known issues apply to Ansible 10.2.0?
Is the ome_smart_fabric_uplink duplicate-name issue in 10.2.0?

answer_card.title: dellemc.openmanage known issues (10.2.0)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `idrac_diagnostics`: no SOCKS proxy export to HTTP/HTTPS shares.
- `idrac_firmware`: no authenticated HTTP/HTTPS/FTP shares on iDRAC8.
- `idrac_storage_volume`: false success on BOSS-N1 when a virtual disk exists.
- `ome_diagnostics`: SupportAssist export fails on OME 4.0.0.
- `ome_smart_fabric_uplink`: a duplicate name modifies the existing uplink.
